correctness.rationale: For every odd n>=5, Fourier/Parseval gives sharp ring energy nJc+na m^2 at prescribed magnetization m; conical configurations attain the bound for all m. Two unit apex spins can realize every resultant s in [0,2], with pair dot product s^2/2-1. The remaining exact quadratic is optimized over [0,1]x[0,2], including both thresholds and all equality cases. The strict nonzero Fourier eigenspace condition and unit spin norm yield the cone and two handednesses. 3901 finite checks verify concrete witness energies, lower bounds, chirality, coexistence, and direct unreduced searches but do not replace the proof.

evidence: Schmidt and Luban 2002 Eq. (79) supplies the exact quadratic energy of an isolated odd classical spin ring at a prescribed total moment; Section 6.3.3 gives a one-apex pentagonal star. Both facts are existing and form the exact starting ingredient here, but no independent apex-apex bond is present in those special examples.
Sklan and Henley 2012 Sections II.1 and V.1 present Luttinger-Tisza and conical spin states for a three-dimensional octahedral/chain setting, not finite bonded double-apex odd cycles.
Jeevanesan and Orth 2014 concerns the coupled triangular and honeycomb windmill lattice with a distinct Hamiltonian and phase diagram.
Florek et al. 2020 Equation (10) has one center s0 and no center-center coupling L.
broader_coverage.reasoning: A full exact ring constrained energy is explicitly covered by Schmidt and Luban 2002 and must not be counted as novel. The new two-apex model differs by having an independently coupled apex pair, whose resultant amplitude is itself variable. General Heisenberg exchange methods are broad, but the inspected paper does not state the resulting first-order pair-alignment and coexistence law.

evidence: Schmidt–Luban 2002 Eq. (79) implies the ring energy nJc+na m^2 in the current one-count-per-bond normalization. It does not by itself supply the apex pair energy L(s^2/2-1), its optimization over s, or the first-order threshold and coexistence in the different two-apex graph.
The 2020 single-center wheel Eq. (10) cannot set a free positive center-center antiferromagnetic exchange L, since that graph has only one apex.
The 2012 conical spiral construction and classical Fourier lower-bound method apply to many Hamiltonians but do not report the two-apex pair-alignment jump at K=sqrt(2aL/n).
A fixed external magnetic field acting on an odd ring can provide the cone energy, but the extra interacting apex pair has a nontrivial energy L(s^2/2-1) and a two-parameter global minimum.
claim_vs_prior_implication.reasoning: The exact fixed-magnetization ring parabola is established prior art. It is combined here with the independently competing two-hub spin resultant; minimizing over that new amplitude yields a discontinuous extremal order parameter and a critical interval. This is a genuine structural extension beyond the one-apex star, though an uninspected general theorem could imply the resulting exact phase diagram.

originality.rationale: Schmidt and Luban (2002) already give the exact quadratic minimum rim energy at fixed total spin (their Eq. 79) and treat a one-apex pentagonal star (Sec. 6.3.3). These components, as well as later conical and single-apex wheel methods, are acknowledged prior art. No examined primary source gives the bonded two-apex odd-rim model with independent antiferromagnetic apex pair and the exact first-order alignment/coexistence/chirality law. Historical priority for the combined specific statement remains provisional.
residual_risks: The exact constrained odd-ring parabola is long established (Schmidt–Luban 2002); novelty pertains only to the extra antiferromagnetic apex-pair optimization and its complete two-apex phase diagram.
A broad older theorem on classical symmetric spin exchange matrices might imply the two-apex classification via a further reduction that has not been located.
Not all historical classical nanomagnet or bipyramidal molecule literature could be inspected in full.
The windmill-lattice article was not reviewed in complete full text; no evidence of identical object appeared in the accessible portions.
A literature search and full inspection of selected sources do not constitute mathematical priority certification.

value.rationale: A bonded two-apex odd-rim magnetic molecule is a natural frustrated graph with a competition between the apex-apex antiferromagnetic exchange and the collective apex-rim exchange. The sharp square-root threshold, discontinuous apex-pair correlation, critical continuum of exact ground states and spontaneously chiral interval are physically interpretable phase invariants, not cosmetic reparametrizations or a known one-apex table. A complete all-odd-size classification has mathematical value independently of finite-temperature or material realization.
